messages.text: Proposal: raise the Pro plan from $19 to $29 next month. Trial conversion is healthy, but support load per Pro customer is much higher than expected.
I support the increase. At $19, gross margin on Pro is below target once onboarding calls are included. The tradeoff is we may lose some price-sensitive solo users.
I'm worried about surprising existing customers. Assuming we grandfather current Pro users for 6 months, the support team can handle the messaging.
Final decision: raise Pro pricing to $29 for new customers starting 2026-08-01, grandfather existing Pro customers for 6 months, and review churn after the first billing cycle.
